about: The data context of the creation windows of the interface. It serves the widget CharacterCreation of a new game and the widget CharacterChangeAppearance, the mirror, which the client opens when a change-appearance session starts.

evidence.says: the interface reports this type name for the data context of the open widget CharacterChangeAppearance

after Osi.StartChangeAppearance(host) the widget CharacterChangeAppearance is the one open widget outside the HUD and its data context is gui::DCCharacterCreation; closing the widget leaves the session standing on both sides (the session entity, the definition entity and CCState.HasDummy remain)
after Osi.StartRespec(host) the widget CharacterRespec is the one open widget outside the HUD, with the same data context

questions.ask: the command of this data context that confirms and the one that cancels a change-appearance session, so that a session is ended and not only hidden
